meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会先分析你的需求（页面类型、风格、受众等），然后选择合适的设计系统或 CSS 方案，生成不套模板的前端代码。
howto.when: 当你要求它制作落地页、作品集或重新设计现有页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 B2B SaaS 的落地页，风格像 Linear。
say.note: Claude 会先输出设计解读，再生成代码。

say.text: 重新设计我的个人作品集，保留现有品牌色。
say.note: Claude 会先审计现有设计，再输出新方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your request (page type, style, audience, etc.), picks a suitable design system or CSS approach, and generates frontend code that avoids template-like appearance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for landing pages, portfolios, or redesigns of existing pages.

say_en.text: Build a B2B SaaS landing page with a Linear-style feel.
say_en.note: Claude will output a design read first, then code.

say_en.text: Redesign my portfolio, preserving existing brand colors.
say_en.note: Claude will audit the current design first.
